selection_rule: Parse set-logic without solving. Take up to 100 formulas from each of the first two lexicographically ordered logics having >=100 eligible formulas, ordered by SHA256(relative_path). Freeze paths before any diagnostic run.

interventions.information: For solver-certified UNSAT source cases, remove one assertion selected deterministically from a native unsat core; retain only constructed cases whose changed satisfiability/derivability status is certified by the native evaluator.
interventions.accessibility: Apply deterministic alpha-renaming plus assertion reordering; require semantic equivalence to be independently solver-checked before inclusion.
interventions.computation: Keep formula and information fixed; impose a frozen low resource limit and then a frozen relaxed limit; include only cases where native custody distinguishes resource exhaustion from semantic failure.

split: SHA256(source_path || intervention_type) low bit: DEVELOPMENT=0, PROTECTED_EVALUATION=1
stop_rule: No threshold, intervention construction, budget, source logic, or corpus membership changes after protected outcomes. Native UNKNOWN/timeout that cannot establish construction gold remains CANNOT_CHECK.
